dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal conjecture on MIS approximability vs. Min Dominating Set
dossier_meta.statement_text: Max Independent Set may have a very different approximability status than Min Dominating Set on bounded twin-width graphs.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 6 establishes $O(1)$-approximation algorithms for Min Dominating Set and Min $r$-Dominating Set on bounded twin-width graphs, but Max Independent Set (Distance-1 MIS) is explicitly excluded from that theorem. The authors note further that a constant approximation for Max Independent Set on bounded twin-width graphs with arbitrarily large clique number would imply a PTAS, and they give some evidence that MIS sits in a fundamentally different approximability regime.
